paper_title: Solving k-SUM Using Few Linear Queries
source_locator: Explicit open question on PDF page 3
statement: Table 1 Complexities of our new algorithms for the k-SUM problem. The query size is the maximum number of elements of the input that can be involved in a single linear query. The number of blocks is a parameter that allows us to change the query size (see Section 5). The origin of the constant in the exponent of the time complexity is due to Lemma 9. We conjecture it can be reduced, though substantial changes in the analysis will likely be needed to do so.
